command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== GO084 LOCAL OBJECT PREFLIGHT READONLY ==='
date -Is; hostname
TARGET=81b92e1b1138fd86f6b011f166f4baa2349fcace
printf 'WORKTREE_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'STATUS='; git status --short --branch | head -20
echo '--- REMOTES (URL REDACTED TO SCHEME/HOST ONLY) ---'
git remote -v | sed -E 's#(https?://)[^/@]+@#\1<redacted>@#g; s#(https?://github.com/)[^ ]+#\1<repo>#g' || true
if git cat-file -e "$TARGET^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo TARGET_OBJECT_PRESENT=1
  git show "$TARGET:werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh" >/tmp/go084-guard-from-object.sh
  git show "$TARGET:werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf" >/tmp/go084-dropin-from-object.conf
  echo TARGET_GUARD_SHA256=$(sha256sum /tmp/go084-guard-from-object.sh | awk '{print $1}')
  echo TARGET_DROPIN_SHA256=$(sha256sum /tmp/go084-dropin-from-object.conf | awk '{print $1}')
  bash -n /tmp/go084-guard-from-object.sh
  grep -Fx 'ExecCondition=/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh' /tmp/go084-dropin-from-object.conf >/dev/null
  grep -Fx 'ExecStopPost=' /tmp/go084-dropin-from-object.conf >/dev/null
  echo TARGET_OBJECT_CONTENT_VALID=1
else
  echo TARGET_OBJECT_PRESENT=0
fi
echo '=== END READONLY ==='
